record: Clearing and the field: docs/LAND_GRANTS.md §5, build step 3
verdictMeaning: A student chooses one of the family's staked plots on the map and sends people to clear it a spell at a time, prairie 10, brush 20, timber 30 with the axe; the work stays when they are called home and everybody stops together when it is cleared; a cleared plot is fenced on its own; the field is the cleared plots, sown and walked to plot by plot, a plot cleared mid-season is not harvested, and the stock take their share only of unfenced plots; ruin returns every plot to staked; automatic families stake, clear and fence; old classes open with their old field as plots and no save version moved.

browserProof.note: Same computer only. MAP=gonzales PORT=8757 SEED=clearing-proof-1, one student family and four automatic, isolated data folder, the in-app browser, host pace set to quick. Not LAN acceptance.
observed: After arrival, Feliciano surveyed 'Ten acres of timber a quarter mile south-west of the house. Clearing it would be 30 spells of work.' and the plot was staked; the first patch showed as a cleared plot beside the house.

'Clear a staked plot' opened 'Which plot Feliciano clears'. A tap on the cleared first patch read 'Ten acres of prairie beside the house, cleared, with no fence. That ground is already cleared.' with no send button; a tap on the staked plot read 'Ten acres of timber a quarter mile south-west of the house, staked. 30 spells of clearing, felling timber with the axe.' and outlined it.

'Clear it' sent Feliciano out, 'felling timber on the clearing'; at 4 of 30 spells the plot showed a small square of turned earth in its middle (__plotsDrawn cleared 0.13). Temperance was sent to the same plot; when it cleared both walked in, the story read 'Temperance finished clearing ten acres of timber a quarter mile south-west of the house. The field is 20 acres now.', the hoe was not worn.
The timber plot was drawn as field, the oak that stood in it gone. Before a fix in this proof, cleared plots were drawn faint and prairie scatter (an oak, scrub) was drawn standing in them.

'Fence a cleared plot' on Temperance, a tap on the first patch, 'Fence it': 'Temperance split rails and fenced the ten acres beside the house. The stock are out of that crop now.'; the rail fence drawn round that plot only; land.harvestShare 0.8333; the land line 'Their land: 20 acres cleared in 2 plots, 1 fenced.'
'Plant the field · 4 seed' was refused with two seed in the house, as it should be; planting and harvest by plot are proved in the tests, not in this browser run.
